title: An endpoint security policy is not assigned

report.title: {Items.Count} endpoint security {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy is', 'policies are')} not assigned

messages.businessImpact: The control was configured and never switched on. It reaches no device, so it protects nobody, while the console shows it as present and everyone assumes it is working.
remediation: Assign each policy listed to the devices it is meant to protect, or delete it if it was superseded.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a policy is assigned is read, not whether the assignment reaches anything. A policy assigned only to an empty group counts as assigned here and is reported by the targeting hygiene rules instead.
